children: Willdan Group is acquiring Mantis Innovation for $285 million in cash. The Houston-based company brings more than 220 employees and specializes in building controls, energy efficiency, energy advisory and facility management solutions. Mantis expands Willdan's commercial market presence in data centers, food and beverage, and healthcare industries, the company says. Willdan plans to fund the transaction using a new $250 million term loan facility alongside cash on hand and existing credit facilities. The deal is subject to Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust clearance and is expected to close in the fourth quarter.
